3.title: Meet Your Cigar
3.learningObjective: Explore the selected cigar’s brand/blend/wrapper/binder/filler/factory profile.
3.canonicalPersistence: smokecraft_activity_attempts (activity_type=exploration, activity_key=meet-your-cigar); smokecraft_tasting_drafts (activityKey=meet-your-cigar, checkpoint draft resume); smokecraft_award_audit (attempt history)
3.notes: Required-Interaction Closure Package D: the 3 sections that ever carry real content for this fixed catalog (Brand/Blend/Wrapper — Binder/Filler/Factory/Master Blender are always "Not available") are now required, server-validated checkpoints, plus a required final synthesis (which detail most influenced the player's impression) before completion. A real pre-existing defect was found and fixed in this pass: smokecraftRewards.js had no entry for this session, so awardSessionRewards() silently no-op'd and the session could never complete server-side through the real path at all, before or after prior packages.

4.title: Terroir
4.learningObjective: Understand how country/region/soil/climate shape a cigar’s character.
4.canonicalPersistence: smokecraft_activity_attempts (activity_type=exploration, activity_key=terroir); smokecraft_tasting_drafts (activityKey=terroir, checkpoint draft resume); smokecraft_award_audit (attempt history)
4.notes: Required-Interaction Closure Package D: the 5 real terroir-shaping factors (Country/Region/Soil/Climate/Growing Conditions) are now required, server-validated checkpoints, plus a required final synthesis (which factor most shapes character) before completion. Same pre-existing missing-reward-table-entry defect as Session 3 was found and fixed here too.

15.title: Knowledge Drop
15.canonicalService: server/services/smokecraft/selectionClassificationService.js#submitSelectionAttempt (SESSION_DEFS["knowledge-drop"], graded against server-owned KNOWLEDGE_DROP_ANSWERS); playerStateService.js#completeSession (gated by hasSelectionEvidence)
15.canonicalPersistence: smokecraft_activity_attempts (activity_type=exploration, activity_key=knowledge-drop); smokecraft_tasting_drafts (activityKey=knowledge-drop, quiz-answer draft resume); smokecraft_award_audit (attempt history)
15.notes: Required-Interaction Closure Package D: the previously-optional, client-graded per-topic quiz is now the required interaction — all 4 topics must be answered correctly, graded server-side against the server's own copy of the real answer key (never the client-visible practice-UI answer field), plus a required final synthesis (most useful topic). Unlike Sessions 3/4, correctness here is objectively graded, matching the real quiz content already authored in this component.
